en.headline: Kennedy Town sea wall proposed for Grade 2 historic status
en.dek: The century-old New Praya structure, a popular waterfront selfie spot, has been recommended for listing after an assessment by the Historic Buildings Assessment Panel.
body: The Historic Buildings Assessment Panel under the Antiquities and Monuments Office has recommended that the New Praya sea wall in Kennedy Town be given Grade 2 historic status. Subject to endorsement, the proposed grading will be uploaded to the Antiquities Advisory Board website for a one-month public consultation.

Authorities said the sea wall may be more than 100 years old and is believed to be one of the oldest surviving along the northern shore of Hong Kong Island. Under the three-tier system, Grade 2 denotes structures of special merit for which selective preservation efforts should be made.

The recommendation comes as the government advances plans for an offshore pedestrian walkway along New Praya that will connect existing promenades. Officials have said the sea wall’s potential heritage value has already been taken into account in the project design and is unlikely to be affected by the proposed grading.

The waterfront stretch has become a well-known photography location, especially at sunset. The Antiquities and Monuments Office document noted that creative storytelling will be important to interpret the site’s history for the public once the grading process is completed.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城新海旁海堤擬列二級歷史建築
zh.dek: 古物古蹟辦事處歷史建築評估小組建議將這道逾百年海堤評為二級，供公眾諮詢一個月。
body: 古物古蹟辦事處轄下歷史建築評估小組建議，將堅尼地城新海旁海堤評為二級歷史建築。若獲通過，建議評級將上載至古物諮詢委員會網站，進行為期一個月的公眾諮詢。
當局指，該海堤可能已有超過100年歷史，相信是港島北岸現存最古老海堤之一。按三級制度，二級屬具特別價值的構築物，應盡量選擇性保存。
建議提出之際，政府正推進沿新海旁興建離岸行人通道的計劃，以連接現有海濱長廊。官員表示，海堤的潛在文物價值已納入工程設計考慮，擬議評級料不會影響項目。
這段海旁近年成為熱門打卡點，尤其日落時分。文件指，評級完成後，以具創意的方式向公眾詮釋該處歷史將十分重要。
